traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points some- where in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

reactions.name: Whirlwind of Sand
reactions.text: Trigger: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Response: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccu- pied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Action Uses
legendaryActions.text: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the mummy can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The mummy regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Dread Command
legendaryActions.text: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spell- casting. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Glare
legendaryActions.text: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
